name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Watermelon Zuntz
description: Created through crossing the classic Watermelon Zkittles x Runtz strains. Reminiscent of ripe watermelons and tangy lemons, this deliciously sweet and fruity strain is meant to provoke a cheerful and euphoric state of mind.
